street_caps: flop/turn table-ACCEPTs are downgraded to LOW at lookup time (STREET_ABSTRACTION_ERROR) — abstraction risk never erased by stable training

path_quality.solver_accepted: held-out exact-game accepted risk: EV regret ~0.12 bb, wrong-action 3.0% (mature slice 0.067 bb / 1.6%); plus measured per-street abstraction error (abstraction_error_summary.json)
path_quality.solver_low_confidence: shown with reasons; DecisionReport treats as advisory
path_quality.rollout_fallback: 20/36 exact-river root agreement, over-bet bias, behaviour-model EV (final_rollout_audit.json); SE-calibrated, warns < 500 samples
path_quality.heuristic_fallback: rules-based; used when rollout unavailable; weakest path

main_remaining_reliability_risk: full-game abstraction floor (restricted-LBR >= ~100 bb/100) and rollout over-bet bias on the rejected-path; both documented, neither fixable by more training
note: no single 'accuracy' number is meaningful across paths; see per-path evidence files
